```yaml
name: Java Snippet Validation

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
      - 'scripts/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
      - 'scripts/**'

jobs:
  validate-snippets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq
        shell: bash

      - name: Ensure only snippet tooling changes
        id: guard
        run: |
          echo "Checking changed files..."
          CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.before }} ${{ github.sha }})
          echo "Changed files: $CHANGED"
          if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -Ev '^(scripts/|\.github/workflows/)' > /dev/null; then
            echo "Non-tooling changes detected. Skipping snippet validation."
            echo "skip=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "skip=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Extract JavaDoc snippets
        id: extract
        if: steps.guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p snippets
          scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh > snippets/snippets.jsonl
          echo "count=$(wc -l < snippets/snippets.jsonl)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

      - name: Validate snippets
        if: steps.guard.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.extract.outputs.count != '0'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            sourceFile=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.sourceFile')
            symbol=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.symbol')
            snippetIndex=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.snippetIndex')
            startLine=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.startLine')
            endLine=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.endLine')
            code=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.code')
            echo "Validating snippet $symbol[$snippetIndex] ($sourceFile:$startLine-$endLine)"
            tmpfile=$(mktemp)
            echo "$code" > "$tmpfile"
            scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh "$tmpfile"
            rm "$tmpfile"
          done < snippets/snippets.jsonl
        shell: bash
```
